scope: Synthetic support-rule qualification only; manuscript closed, H/F never pooled.
rule: Use body-selected position matching from preceding diagnostic. In each discordant-row group with n lines and k left-sh, support Vg=k*(n-k)/n. Sum Vg >=80, at least8pages with V>0, and max page share<=.25. Uses bodies, positions and prefix margins only; never qok or outcomes. Threshold80 is a proposed conservative design threshold, not an empirically established minimum.
target: Detect conditional+.15 qok probability at baseline.2 or.6, exact one-sided test Bonferroni8. This is minimum-effect-specific, not capacity to detect arbitrarily small associations.
design: 100fresh datasets for each4designs:6fragmented,24fragmented,96fragmented,24aligned lines/page;12pages8positions. Scenarios iidnull psh=pq=.5; additive-null logit page+line+position amplitudes.5 for both independently;+.15 at baseline.2;+.15 at baseline.6. Prefixes p=.5 for positives. Fresh seeds1010000+cell*1000+trial.
gates: Every approved positive cell needs>=50 eligible trials and Wilson95 lower power>=.80. Every approved null cell needs>=50 eligible trials and upper false-flag bound<=.10. Cells with zero admissions are excluded scope, not failed effects; 1..49 admissions are insufficient qualification and fail broad rule. At least one eligible cell for each scenario required. Rejects retained unscored. Do not change threshold after results. Any power/calibration/coverage failure blocks general support-rule qualification.
verification: Support independence from outcomes is checked by complementing qok on every dataset. Imported exact engine unchanged, hash frozen. Eligibility selection precedes p calculation. No manuscript application even if synthetic passes.
limits: V is assignment variation, not observed outcome variation. Body-selected matchings only, event-level generator, fixed lengths. Does not establish actual manuscript availability, parsing or H/F alignment. Sparse design rejection is abstention, not negative evidence.
